paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:1 he speaks in the name of Rabbi Lazar son of Rabbi Yose (the Amora).[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:1 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Tanchum of Kefar Gun reporting Rabbi Lazar son of Rabbi Yose. It later gives a separate reverse reporting formula; that second formula is not substituted into Hyman’s sentence. The corresponding full titles are locally supported, while “the Amora” remains Hyman’s classification.
